tools.name: make_invoice
tools.description: Lay out a PDF invoice from the details the user gives: who sends it, who pays, and the lines (description, quantity, unit price, VAT %). Shows a preview, and returns a dozokit.com link that opens the invoice filled in, where the user checks it and downloads the PDF, made on their device. Use lang fr
